name: Matjaž Nemec-After § 27-Am 31
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 27b. Opposes the absurd renovation of the Spaak building of the European Parliament in Brussels, imposed by the Bureau in December 2023, with an astronomical cost estimated between EUR 455 and 490 million (as of April 2023), while Strasbourg remains the official seat of the European Parliament; recalls that the existence of a dual seat generates an additional cost estimated by the Court of Auditors in 2014 at EUR 114 million per year;
